title: Space setup: a new Business or Nonprofit Space walks its owner through seeding before the Circles manager

source.ref: ADR-1733: owner ruling 2026-10-12, "it just created it and dumped me in a circle"

detail: BUILT 2026-10-12 (ADR-1733, amends LIVE-261's landing). lib/spaces/setup.ts (pure): postCreateLanding(type, slug) sends a console type (business, nonprofit) to /spaces/<slug>/setup and every other type to /spaces/<slug>/manage/circles; spaceSetupSteps(SPACE_MANIFEST) reads the walk off the manifest's sections (story, identity, contact and links, offerings, then First things); spaceSetupFields drops the spark fields creation already asked. createSpace (lib/spaces/provision.ts) redirects through postCreateLanding. The route app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/setup/page.tsx gates on resolveSpaceManageAccess canManage and isConsoleSpaceType; space-setup-spark.tsx composes SparkShell and saves every step through the existing actions (updateSpaceProfile, setSpaceBusinessInfo, setSpaceImages, uploadSpaceImage, setSpaceAccent), so leaving mid-way loses nothing. Vera drafts the tagline and the story through suggestTaglineAction and draftSpaceBioAction, never blocking. First things offers the Circle wizard (/circles/new) and the Event Spark hosted by the Space (/events/new?space=<id>), both skippable; the finish lands on /manage/circles. ProfileCompletenessCard takes setupHref and offers Finish setting up to an older console Space while incomplete; menu catalogs untouched. Stale comments fixed in provision.ts, create-space-form.tsx and bundles.ts; docs/STUDIO.md's wizards cell no longer says none yet. Tests: lib/spaces/setup.test.ts, lib/spaces/provision.test.ts. LEFT OUT: the short About and the offering blurbs are veraDrafts in the manifest but have no draft seam, so they are typed; no website research door for members (the Seeder's, on purpose); no @wizard intercept route, since createSpace arrives by server redirect.
